scope: All operative NCCP sections in 00244v5/00382v4, with explicit selected current SmPC safety supplements. Descriptive adverse-event frequencies are not exhaustive automated decision logic.

criteria.criterion: Adult CRC or GIST indication and required prior treatment
criteria.detail: Clinician confirms indication and previous therapies; no histology/line is inferred. Adult age is verified manually; no automatic age eligibility calculation.

criteria.criterion: ECOG 0–1 and adequate organ reserve
criteria.detail: No invented numerical marrow or renal eligibility cutoff.

criteria.criterion: Regimen exclusions, including cardiac history and severe hepatic impairment
criteria.detail: NCCP says recent MI without a numeric interval; input explains EMA trial exclusion within six months as supplementary context, not an inferred absolute NCCP cutoff.

criteria.criterion: Caution for hypersensitivity to another drug in the same class
Consultant initiation, response review and duration
criteria.detail: Clinical authority, shared treatment decision and response assessment cannot be inferred from laboratory values.

criteria.criterion: Reference oral schedule, 40 mg steps and 80–160 mg daily limits
criteria.detail: Schedule renderer now has explicit dosing-day array and component attribution; actual prescription may start lower. No automatic current dose from reference160.

criteria.criterion: Conflicting NCCP food instructions resolved by current EMA administration instructions
criteria.detail: NCCP same paragraph also says with or without food; both retained in source discrepancy log. Swallow whole, same-day missed dose only, no doubling or replacement after vomiting.

criteria.criterion: Baseline investigations and conditional cardiac/pancreatic tests
criteria.detail: Retained in protocol supportive notes and patient monitoring plan; attendance/results review must be confirmed clinically.

criteria.criterion: Regular investigations, early liver/BP frequency and warfarin monitoring
criteria.detail: Event-specific liver weekly monitoring is separate. No universal disease-scan interval is invented.

criteria.criterion: Renal impairment and haemodialysis recommendations
criteria.detail: No arbitrary eGFR cutoff or automatic numeric reduction.

criteria.criterion: Child-Pugh A/B recommendations and unresolved NCCP–EMA difference for B
criteria.detail: Explicit consultant review; do not convert either statement into automatic clearance or a fabricated dose.

criteria.criterion: Grade 1 HFSR: support without automatic reduction
First grade 2 HFSR: reduction history and response to the initial reduction
Persistent, second or third grade 2 HFSR: interruption, recovery and reduction
Fourth grade 2 HFSR: permanent discontinuation
First or second grade 3 HFSR: at least seven days of interruption and recovery
criteria.detail: Missing occurrence does not cancel current grade3 hold. Minimum7day flag is explicitly tied to qualifying HFSR episode.

criteria.criterion: Third grade 3 HFSR: permanent discontinuation
HFSR re-escalation requires a discretionary clinical decision
criteria.detail: Clinical restart approval, source recovery and actual dose needed; never auto-re-escalate.

criteria.criterion: ALT/AST ≤5 × ULN: domain-specific advice and monitoring
criteria.detail: Does not cancel other holds or authorise the complete regimen.

criteria.criterion: First ALT/AST >5 to ≤20 × ULN: hold, recovery and conditional restart
criteria.detail: The current hold is independent of missing recurrence; benefit/risk remains consultant judgement.

criteria.criterion: Recurrent ALT/AST >5 × ULN or any >20 × ULN: permanent stop
Combined transaminase/bilirubin elevation and the confirmed Gilbert exception
criteria.detail: Unknown Gilbert status holds pending clarification; confirmedGilbert uses transaminase rows and never cancels>20/recurrent stop. Real lab adapter tests higher ALT/AST using each ownULN.

criteria.criterion: Grade 1 hypertension: monitoring
Asymptomatic grade 2 hypertension and the unresolved printed BP criterion
criteria.detail: Printed diastolic rise >200mmHg is unresolved; clinician-confirmed grade is used, not a silently corrected >20 threshold.

criteria.criterion: Symptomatic grade 2 or grade 3 hypertension: hold, recovery and dose review
Numerical severe-BP boundary and its overlap with recovery wording
criteria.detail: DBP100 overlaps recovery≤100; numberalone never authorisesrestart. Conservative hold/review is explicitly labelled, not a definitive clinical grade diagnosis.

criteria.criterion: Grade 4 hypertension or hypertensive crisis: discontinuation
Hypertension interruption duration, dose floor and re-escalation conditions
criteria.detail: Delay attributed tohypertension explicitly. Historical reductions after re-escalation cannot bythemselves falselyprove current dosefloor.

criteria.criterion: Other grade 3–4 toxicities: interruption and source-specific recovery
criteria.detail: No standalone grade2 permanentstop; grade4 discretionary discontinuation remains consultantdecision.

criteria.criterion: Other-toxicity four-week non-recovery and recurrence after re-escalation
Table 5 exclusions and separate toxicity pathways
criteria.detail: Explicit classification input; neither unknownexception nor generic grade alonecalculatesdose.

criteria.criterion: Regorafenib emetogenic risk, usual premedication and HFSR support
criteria.detail: Prescribed breakthroughplan andlocal skin/footcare; no chemotherapy-style antiemetic regimen borrowed.

criteria.criterion: Explicit current SmPC safety pathways
criteria.detail: Temporaryholds for urgentreview distinguish SmPC considerpermanentdiscontinuation fromdefinite permanentstops. Symptoms do notimplyconfirmed diagnoses.

criteria.criterion: Explicit current SmPC interaction review
criteria.detail: Pharmacy review remains necessary for the full medicationlist; flags are not a comprehensive interaction database.

criteria.criterion: Additional clinical precautions and reproductive counselling
criteria.detail: Relevantclinicalhistory, investigations and contraception discussion recorded by treatingteam; no fabricated universal test/date ordose.

criteria.criterion: Adult colorectal monotherapy indication and previous treatment
criteria.detail: Gastric/SUNLIGHT-bevacizumab contexts remain separate; adultage andspecificprevious agents verifiedclinically.

criteria.criterion: Lonsurf performance status, organ function and exclusions
Starting oral schedule, per-dose cap and reference dosing
criteria.detail: SourceBSA table mustbeverified bypharmacy; noarithmeticrounding calculator orautomaticpatient-specificdose.

criteria.criterion: BSA tablet tables and unequal morning/evening doses at 50 mg daily
criteria.detail: SourcePDFtables retained. 50mg/day means20mgAM+30mgPM. ExactBSA tablet lookup is deliberately notautomated; verifytable/applicable doselevel ratherthan borrowing standard35mg bands for renal/reduceddoses.

criteria.criterion: Administration after meals and missed/held-dose instructions
criteria.detail: Vomiteddose no-replacement is supportedbycurrentEMA patientinstructions. Patient followspharmacycalendar.

criteria.criterion: Consultant initiation and dose-modification authority
criteria.detail: Noengineoutput authorisesprescription; benefit,response andpatientpriorities reviewedbyteam.

criteria.criterion: Baseline and before-cycle investigations
criteria.detail: No universalDay15bloodtest orscaninterval invented; extraCBC asclinically indicated.

criteria.criterion: Standard dose reductions, dose floor and prohibition of re-escalation
criteria.detail: Severerenal20→15pathway isdistinct; noadditive simultaneous toxicityreductions.

criteria.criterion: During-cycle ANC and platelet interruption thresholds
New-cycle count minima and conflicting assessment timing
criteria.detail: Restartandnewcycle separatedfromduringdosing; discordant timingreview cannotcancelmore restrictivecountfinding.

criteria.criterion: Febrile neutropenia, recovery and reduction from the previous dose
Previous severe nadir causing more than seven days of cycle delay
criteria.detail: Nadirhistorynotinferredfromcurrentcounts; delaycauseconfirmed byclinicalinput.

criteria.criterion: Source-specific renal boundaries, including the EMA lower limit
criteria.detail: EMA lower15boundary prevents extrapolating NCCP<30row; exactclearancevslegacyband discrepancies explicitlyreviewed.

criteria.criterion: Severe-renal minimum dose and intolerance of that minimum
Baseline moderate/severe hepatic impairment
criteria.detail: Mildhepatic noadjustment; currentabnormalresult requiresbaselineclassificationandcause review, not anautomatic dose.

criteria.criterion: Non-haematological toxicity and controlled grade 3 GI exceptions
criteria.detail: Unknown GIcontrol neverassumed; grade4retainsurgenthold. Previousstandardorrenalminimum respected.

criteria.criterion: Lonsurf nausea risk, hydration, symptom support and driving advice
criteria.detail: Patientandpharmacyindividual supportplan. Nofixedparenteralantiemeticscheduleautomaticallyapplied.

criteria.criterion: Specified rare hereditary sugar disorders
criteria.detail: Not equatedwithordinary nonspecificlactose symptoms.

criteria.criterion: Contraception and hormonal-method counselling
criteria.detail: CurrentNCCP andEMA reproductivecounselling, not anautomated pregnancytestorstopdate calculator.

criteria.criterion: Enhanced blood-count monitoring with renal impairment
criteria.detail: Noinventedfixedfrequency beyondsource.

criteria.criterion: Infection and unresolved severe toxicity before initiation
criteria.detail: Infectiondoesnot itselfprovetheneutropeniadose-reductioncriterion.

criteria.criterion: Thymidine-kinase substrate and transporter interaction review
criteria.detail: Checkfullmedicationlistwithpharmacy; noautomaticnumericdosefrominteractionflag.

limitations: Manual clinical criteria and source-table tablet verification are explicit; encoded coverage does not mean clinical authorisation.
The scenarios exercise each current rule, threshold edges and important interactions, not every possible combination of patient states.
